description: A reference-modified control name: the CONTROL clause's data-name-1 and the TYPE clause's CONTROL HEADING / CONTROL FOOTING operand (kb/Work PB5573). §1985:III.2 says a general format's 'data-name' "must not be reference-modified, subscripted, or qualified unless specifically permitted by the rules of the format", and §1985:XIII.3.7.3 SR1 permits the CONTROL operand qualification only ("Data-name-1 may be qualified"); no 1985 rule permits reference modification of any control name. ISO/IEC 1989:2002 adds it: 13.16.15.2 SR4 ("Data-name-1 may be reference modified") and 13.16.55.2 SR10 ("Data-name-1 and data-name-2 may be qualified and reference modified"), §2023:13.18.16.3 SR4 and §2023:13.18.57.3 SR10 in the 2023 text. Only the reference modifier is gated: a subscripted control name is refused at every edition (COBOL1699, COBOL0899), and a qualified one is COBOL-85 in the CONTROL clause by SR1 and in the TYPE clause by the reading kb/Work PB5573 records. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.GateCobol85ControlName, which VisitReportControlClause and VisitReportControlName both call, once per written operand.
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (85->2002: a control name may be reference modified)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRCR.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "VMRCR.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WK PIC X(2) VALUE "AB".
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 CONTROL IS WK (1:1) PAGE LIMIT IS 10 LINES.
01 CH1 TYPE CONTROL HEADING WK (1:1) LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "CH".
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "DE".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
